You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0287.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords={}; names={}
def atom(name, el, xy):
    a=Chem.Atom(el); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[idx]=xy; names[name]=idx; return idx
def b(a,b,order=1,dir=None):
    i=names[a] if isinstance(a,str) else a; j=names[b] if isinstance(b,str) else b
    bt={1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE,3:Chem.BondType.TRIPLE,'ar':Chem.BondType.AROMATIC}[order]
    rw.AddBond(i,j,bt)
    bo=rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j)
    if order=='ar':
        rw.GetAtomWithIdx(i).SetIsAromatic(True);rw.GetAtomWithIdx(j).SetIsAromatic(True);bo.SetIsAromatic(True)
    if dir: bo.SetBondDir(dir)
    return bo
# indole fused aromatic system (coordinates in image space; y down)
atom('A','C',(282,119)); atom('B','C',(351,21)); atom('C','C',(471,33)); atom('D','C',(521,144)); atom('E','C',(451,239)); atom('F','C',(329,228));
atom('X','C',(635,180)); atom('Y','C',(635,299)); atom('NH','N',(520,337))
# fused aromatic bonds
for x,y in [('A','B'),('B','C'),('C','D'),('D','E'),('E','F'),('F','A'),('D','X'),('X','Y'),('Y','NH'),('NH','E')]: b(x,y,'ar')
# aryl methoxy
atom('Oind','O',(205,110)); atom('Mind','C',(145,105)); b('A','Oind'); b('Oind','Mind')
# six member ring fused to indole: X-U-V-Nt-Q-Y-X
atom('U','C',(739,119)); atom('V','C',(843,180)); atom('Nt','N',(843,304)); atom('Q','C',(739,358));
b('X','U'); b('U','V'); b('V','Nt'); b('Nt','Q'); b('Q','Y')
# other core six ring Q-Nt-C1-C2-S-R-Q
atom('C1','C',(946,358)); atom('C2','C',(946,480)); atom('S','C',(843,539)); atom('R','C',(739,480));
b('Nt','C1'); b('C1','C2'); b('C2','S'); b('S','R'); b('R','Q')
# lower ring S-C2-C3-C4-C5-C6-S
atom('C3','C',(1051,539)); atom('C4','C',(1051,658)); atom('C5','C',(947,718)); atom('C6','C',(843,658));
b('C2','C3'); b('C3','C4'); b('C4','C5'); b('C5','C6'); b('C6','S')
# explicit depicted stereogenic H atoms
atom('HQ','H',(675,392)); b('Q','HQ',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
atom('HC2','H',(1010,443)); b('C2','HC2',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
atom('HS','H',(775,584)); b('S','HS',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
# methyl ester substituent at C6: C(=O)OMe
atom('CE','C',(739,718)); atom('OEcarbonyl','O',(739,655)); atom('OEester','O',(675,749)); atom('ME','C',(616,777));
b('C6','CE',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE); b('CE','OEcarbonyl',2); b('CE','OEester'); b('OEester','ME')
# OMe on C5, dashed
atom('O5','O',(947,800)); atom('M5','C',(947,857)); b('C5','O5',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH); b('O5','M5')
# benzoate substituent through oxygen at C4
atom('Oacyl','O',(1120,700)); atom('Cbz','C',(1258,658)); atom('Obz','O',(1258,588));
b('C4','Oacyl',1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE); b('Oacyl','Cbz'); b('Cbz','Obz',2)
# trimethoxy benzene ring
atom('P0','C',(1360,718)); atom('P1','C',(1465,658)); atom('P2','C',(1568,718)); atom('P3','C',(1568,837)); atom('P4','C',(1465,899)); atom('P5','C',(1360,837));
for x,y in [('P0','P1'),('P1','P2'),('P2','P3'),('P3','P4'),('P4','P5'),('P5','P0')]: b(x,y,'ar')
b('Cbz','P0')
# methoxy at P2,P3,P4
for nm,ring,oxy,methyl,xyO,xyM in [
    ('a','P2','Op2','Mp2',(1640,680),(1695,650)),
    ('b','P3','Op3','Mp3',(1635,875),(1693,906)),
    ('c','P4','Op4','Mp4',(1465,970),(1465,1035))]:
    atom(oxy,'O',xyO); atom(methyl,'C',xyM); b(ring,oxy);b(oxy,methyl)

mol=rw.GetMol()
# Set 2D coordinates for assignment helpers
conf=Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in coords.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x,-y,0.0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
# assign chiral tags from the directed bonds (image wedges)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('formula before H',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mol))
for i,a in enumerate(mol.GetAtoms()):
    if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:
        print(names.get(next((n for n,j in names.items() if j==i),''),''), i, a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
# Hydrogen addition and embedding
mh=Chem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=True)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=287; params.useRandomCoords=False
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
  params.useRandomCoords=True; res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params); print('retry',res)
if res>=0:
  # MMFF optimize
  print('MMFF?',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mh))
  if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mh):
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh, maxIters=1000)
  # check chirality preserved
  Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(mh)
  print('3D stereo',[(i,a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()) if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')])
  # output
  conf=mh.GetConformer()
  with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\nReserpine; stereochemistry follows the drawing\n')
    for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()):
      p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
      f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .6f} {p.y: .6f} {p.z: .6f}\n')
  print(Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(mh),mh.GetNumAtoms())

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords=[]; names={}
def atom(name,el='C',arom=False,xy=(0,0)):
    idx=rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el)); names[name]=idx; coords.append((xy[0],xy[1],0.0));
    if arom: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).SetIsAromatic(True)
    return idx
def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],typ)
# Core with screenshot-derived 2d coordinates (image y inverted for drawing coords is okay)
for c,h in [('C','HC'),('D','HD'),('E','HE'),('J','HJ'),('I','HI'),('L','HL')]:bond(c,h)
# set wedge / dash with center first
rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(names['E'],names['HE']).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(names['I'],names['HI']).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(names['L'],names['HL']).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,p in enumerate(coords):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,p)
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
print('stereotags before H')
for n in ['B','C','D','E','I','J','L','M']:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(names[n]); print(n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
# add missing H, preserving the explicits
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('after add H')
for n in ['B','C','D','E','I','J','L','M']:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(names[n]); print(n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
# write mol debug smiles
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# embedding with defined stereocenters
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=9283;params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
  raise SystemExit('embed failed')
print('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m))
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)
print('3d stereos')
for n in ['B','C','D','E','I','J','L','M']:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(names[n]);print(n,a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-',a.GetChiralTag())
# xyz
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated structure\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  x,y,z=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {x: .6f} {y: .6f} {z: .6f}\n')
